te: The Ashmolean Museum in Oxford, England, opens as the world's first university museum.
dz: 英国牛津的Ashmolean博物馆作为世界上第一座大学博物馆开馆.
de: The Ashmolean Museum in Oxford, England, opens as the world's first university museum.

dz: 新教联盟正式解散.
de: The Protestant Union is formally dissolved.

dz: 瑞典的埃里克十四世和他的卫兵谋杀了五名被监禁的瑞典贵族.

dz: 十岁的兰伯特·西姆内尔被加冕于爱尔兰都柏林的基督教堂大教堂,取名"爱德华六世"以图威胁亨利七世国王的统治.

de: The Fifth Crusade leaves Acre for Egypt.

de: The nobles of Franconia and Saxony elect Henry the Fowler at the Imperial Diet in Fritzlar as king of the East Frankish Kingdom.
